goal: Deliver consumer-bound Rust free-function rename and scalar signature migration through one reviewed check/history/patch workflow.
subset: Rust free functions; strong indexed references; no rename warnings. Signature removal/reordering requires primitive scalar parameters and literal call arguments; no runtime/external consumer or source correspondence proof.
cases: effectful arguments and function values refuse
scope escape and batch overlap refuse
stale reviews and clipped diffs refuse
oracle: Independent rustc compiler and public output matrix, exact byte reversal and Git patch receiver. Deterministic acceptance, not live-agent measurements.
direct_edit_boundary: New files, enum/module wiring, Lean/prose/config and formatting use direct edits. Existing admitted bodies are edited using reviewed fr author batches on this repository.
